body: filemark apps/desktop (Electron host) MUST use electron-vite ^3.x, NOT 2.x: electron-vite 2.3 peer-requires vite ^4||^5 but the monorepo standardizes on vite 6 (electron-vite 3 adds vite 6 support). Scaffold mirrors apps/playground conventions (React 19, Tailwind v4 @tailwindcss/vite, workspace:* deps). electron.vite.config.ts uses externalizeDepsPlugin() for main+preload so native modules (libsql, P2) resolve at runtime not bundle time. Renderer reuses @filemark/mdx unchanged via ViewerProps — Phase 1 build-verified.
